article.hook: You want to hold onto something you can’t quite grasp. Saturn in Pisces asks us to build boundaries around what usually drifts - faith, intuition, daydreams. It’s about making the invisible real enough to live with for two and a half years.
article.lived: For about two and a half years, the hard edges come to things you thought were soft or vague. Meetings where decisions depend on gut feelings demand clear yes or no answers. Commitments to ideals get tested by deadlines and budget sheets. We notice when kindness needs rules, and guess what - those rules can still be gentle enough to breathe under.
article.turn: The gift flips when sensitivity becomes a fortress of denial. You hold so tightly to your version of compassion that you stop hearing the real needs beneath. Boundaries turn to walls, and faith becomes avoidance. When you confuse surrender with checking out, you’re not protecting spirit - you’re burying it alive.
moves: Write a one-paragraph rule for how you’ll protect your emotional energy this week.
Schedule a 30-minute meeting to translate one vague goal into a clear, trackable step.
Read one poem or passage that unsettles your usual sense of control and note what sticks with you.
